Consent & Acknowledgment

Human Healthcare Professional Priority

Your licensed healthcare professional (doctor, physical therapist, or coach) is the primary decision-maker for all aspects of your care. This platform uses AI technology to assist and enhance assessments, but all AI-generated content must be reviewed and approved by a qualified human healthcare professional before being used in your treatment. You have the right to consult with your healthcare provider at any time and to decline AI-assisted services if you prefer traditional methods only.
